raw_text: Confirmed: Hamas fighters have infiltrated Israeli territory by land, sea, and air using paragliders. Multiple kibbutzim under attack including Be'eri and Kfar Aza. Reports of hostage-taking. IDF caught completely off guard — this is a massive intelligence failure. Security cameras and dashcam footage showing armed fighters inside settlements.
clean_text: Hamas infiltrated Israel by land, sea, and paragliders. Kibbutzim Be'eri and Kfar Aza under attack. Hostage-taking reported. IDF caught off guard. Fighters inside settlements.
